scope: local isolated tests with mock SSH/systemd
checks: elapsed time never promotes missing progress to WARNING
INFO uses the independently confirmed operation state
confirmed observer/protocol faults have allowlisted WARNING reasons
permission denial differs from a temporary journal read failure
no exception text, credentials or signed URLs in diagnostics
same diagnostic suppressed until state/reason changes or recovery
legacy worker without a reason is not treated as a confirmed fault
missing journal before configure is not a confirmed problem
cursor save error is a local WARNING and preserves its old position
result, operation ID, launch count, execution deadline and cleanup rules preserved
limitation: Locally verified only; the cause of the prior live generic warning was not inferred.
